why: Pass priority to proceed to Declare Blockers phase. I've successfully declared Kird Ape as attacker (dealt 1 damage: opponent now at 16). Casting Brute Force now (costing 1R to pump Kird Ape +1/+2) would deal 2 damage total instead of 1, but the marginal 1-point improvement doesn't alter the losing race calculation—opponent still deals lethal before my Bonebreaker Giant turns the game around. Preserving turn efficiency is more important than squeezing 1 extra damage in a terminal position. If opponent declares blockers (unlikely—Courser can't block), I retain the option to cast Brute Force as an instant later.
